# sequentialist-markets

> Planned application package for sequential market/risk workflows and strategy deterioration. Documentation only: no implementation, package release, trading strategy or performance result exists in this repository yet.

## Current documentation

- [Repository status](https://github.com/andre-a-no/sequentialist-markets/blob/main/README.md): intended ecosystem placement and absent implementation.
- [Planning overview and FAQ](https://github.com/andre-a-no/sequentialist-markets/blob/main/docs/overview.md): possible tasks, required future inputs/outputs, open choices and limits.
- [Обзор планов на русском](https://github.com/andre-a-no/sequentialist-markets/blob/main/docs/overview.ru.md): возможные задачи, будущие входные данные и результаты, открытые вопросы и ограничения.
- [Development guidance](https://github.com/andre-a-no/sequentialist-markets/blob/main/AGENTS.md): documentation boundaries and truthful status reporting.

## Related ecosystem foundations

- [sequential-analysis](https://github.com/andre-a-no/sequential-analysis): statistical procedures.
- [sequential-search](https://github.com/andre-a-no/sequential-search): generic search algorithms and contracts.
- [sequential-games](https://github.com/andre-a-no/sequential-games): stochastic interaction models.
- [sequentialist-core](https://github.com/andre-a-no/sequentialist-core): application execution, storage and audit.
- [sequentialist-visuals](https://github.com/andre-a-no/sequentialist-visuals): reusable engineering views.

Links describe planned repository documentation after publication. This index does not imply an available package, financial recommendation, regulatory approval, or guaranteed ingestion by an assistant or search engine.
